name: Elevar
description: Server-side tracking and Conversions API integration for Shopify.
pros: Industry standard for GTM on Shopify
cons: Expensive monthly recurring cost for a data layer
Requires technical GTM knowledge to fully utilize
The free CAPI Shield method achieves the same result for $0
pricingScaling: Priced on order volume. As you scale past 1,000 orders per month, the cost increases significantly for the exact same server infrastructure.

name: Triple Whale
description: All-in-one attribution and data platform for e-commerce.
pros: Makes blended ROAS easy to understand
cons: Relying heavily on browser pixels which are blocked by iOS
Does not natively fix the Meta algorithm like CAPI does
pricingScaling: Triple Whale charges based on your store's total GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). If you have a high-revenue, low-margin business, this pricing model destroys profits.

name: Klaviyo
description: Email and SMS marketing automation designed for e-commerce.
pros: Industry standard with massive integration ecosystem
cons: Support is slow on lower tiers
pricingScaling: Klaviyo penalizes you for growing your list. Expanding from 10k to 50k subscribers increases your bill exponentially, even if those users rarely buy.
